description: This file defines an interface 'ExecutionContext' that provides methods for storing and retrieving arbitrary key/value pairs, as well as managing an OpenTracing SpanContext for distributed tracing within a Java-based software project.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: An interface for context that can hold key/value pairs and an OpenTracing span context for distributed tracing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or null if unknown.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, returning defaultValue if unknown.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the context.

methods.name: setTracingContext
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing SpanContext used for tracing.

methods.name: getTracingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenTracing SpanContext, if set.
